title: BAD: BiAs Detection for Large Language Models in the context of candidate screening

bias_targets.methodology: Generating resumes from prompts using gender-correlated names and analyzing the resulting distribution of assigned job titles and areas compared to labor force statistics, as well as administering a multiple-choice Context Association Test (CAT) to measure preferences for stereotypical versus neutral associations.

Prompting models to generate resumes using names strongly correlated with specific ethnic groups (White, Black, API, Hispanic) to evaluate skewed occupational sorting, alongside an adapted multiple-choice Context Association Test (CAT) to assess stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and neutral associations based on racial contexts.
